method: Local read-only source inspection; no external provider call and no numerical benchmark.

findings.classification: concrete source-level generalization defect; inherited, not evidence of cheating
findings.evidence: The grouped-pair loop collects every parameter but append_information runs after that loop using only its last optimized_component. Earlier group members with carrier update instructions can remain at base values unless separately scheduled.
findings.repair_comparison: 3b107d69 schedules each member inside the loop.

findings.evidence: No-link setup appends identity to global LINKING_FUNCTIONS but selects index0, not the appended identity index. If a prior setup registered a nonidentity function first, a later no-link setup can apply that function to parameter0.
findings.repair_comparison: 3b107d69 obtains the actual identity function registry index.

findings.evidence: Carrier update scheduling follows named optimization/changing components, with no scan for other instructions consuming those changed parameter indices. Hidden setups with dependent/link-driven carrier components need explicit coverage.
findings.repair_comparison: 3b107d69 additionally schedules unscheduled carrier instructions reading updated parameter indices.

findings.classification: environment-dependent path difference, not automatic numerical failure
findings.evidence: Private SuperLU path sets PanelSize=1,Relax=1; public splu fallback leaves these at defaults. Numeric equations unchanged, but timing and floating-point behavior may differ by SciPy/private-extension availability.
findings.repair_comparison: 3b107d69 default paths match; frozen tuning menu updates both private and public paths together.

findings.classification: numerical robustness validation requirement, not automatic incorrectness
findings.evidence: All sparse solves always apply one correction, without adaptive residual criterion. This may be entirely sufficient for tested setups; fixed one-step count alone does not demonstrate a bug. New ill-conditioned topologies require the actual official and gradient checks.
findings.repair_comparison: Our repaired implementation retains its existing up-to-three-step refinement and residual threshold.

findings.evidence: Complex abs tangent divides by out=abs(x). At x=0 with an active tangent this expression produces 0/0. Whether a supported optical component exercises this path was not established in this read-only audit.
findings.repair_comparison: Not asserted as a differentiator versus our implementation; shared interpreter ancestry requires separate scrutiny.

positive_checks.finding: Signal/noise sparse patterns union initial nonzero coordinates with ALL update coordinates, preserving initially zero entries that may change.
Gradient uses explicit A^-T signal and conjugated A^-1 noise adjoint solves; no approximate collinearity/Hermitian reuse predicate found.
Two-entry forward-state cache keyed by evaluation token supports backward factor reuse; evicted state recomputes forward from supplied inputs. Not a disk answer cache or fixture result lookup.

Kernel cache stores traced function/shape programs; real-input and supported-primitives guards choose host versus JAX fallback. Not benchmark-name dispatch. Unsupported primitives are checked for both value and tangent support at construction.

No benchmark-name or101/193/751 fixture dispatch, fixture file reading, precomputed answer table, or persistent compilation cache found in reviewed nine files. This is a bounded source audit, not proof of universal correctness.

verdict: No deliberate fixture specialization identified. Concrete inherited builder generalization defects and portability/edge concerns prevent universal correctness claim. Current benchmark feasibility belongs to parent evaluator; these source findings do not predict its outcome.
